definitions.explanation: any dishonest, illegal, or unethical action, especially in professional, academic, or institutional settings

examples.japanese: {不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Cheating on the exam was discovered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{内部|ないぶ}{告発|こくはつ}→内部告発：24691_naibukokuhatsu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: Accounting fraud was brought to light through an internal whistleblower.

notes:
A formal compound noun combining ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧ (injustice, dishonesty) and ⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (act, conduct). Used across many domains including law, business, academics, and sports to describe any wrongful action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to commit misconduct
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}する→防止する：17342_boushisuru⟧: to prevent misconduct
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧: misconduct is discovered
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関与|かんよ}→関与：08646_kanyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be involved in misconduct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {違法行為|いほうこうい}: illegal act — specifically actions that violate the law
- ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧: scandal, disgrace — broader term covering embarrassing incidents
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧: crime — more serious than misconduct; always illegal
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧: fraud, dishonesty — the component word used alone as a more general term
